context: Doora Thumbfoot is a desperate halfling vendor standing outside the Elfsong trying to sell the only valuable thing she has left: a necklace that belonged to her grandmother. She needs the coin to buy two berths on a smuggler’s sloop to Waterdeep so she and her husband Maryk can flee Baldur’s Gate—Maryk is being hunted by Lord Gortash, so they must leave quickly. The smuggler demands a fortune, which is why Doora is anxious, reluctant, and pleading even as she offers the heirloom. This is a small, personal crisis set against wider unrest in the city (and separate druidic disturbances happening off‑screen).
